notes: Empty arg yields "<Cmd> what?" (capitalized per subcmd).
Neither object nor door found: find_door reports it is not here.
open <container> opens a closed container (actor + room).
open <door> opens a closed door (actor + room).
Opening an already-open door yields "But it's currently open!".
close <door> closes an open door (actor + room).
Closing an already-closed door yields "But it's already closed!".
find_door resolves a door by direction keyword (e.g. "open north").
